description.p: YarmiplayServerTV runs a Syncplay server and a Jellyfin server from the system tray, so friends can watch videos in sync from your media library with YarmiplayTV or any Syncplay client.

ul.li: A Syncplay 1.7 compatible server with rooms, an optional password, chat and a shared playlist
A Jellyfin media server, set up from the control panel
Optional UPnP port forwarding so people outside your home network can connect
Free encrypted connections with a DuckDNS domain and a Let's Encrypt certificate
Starts with your session and keeps running in the tray

description.p: Jellyfin is developed by the Jellyfin project and included unmodified under its own license.

screenshot.caption: The dashboard with the Syncplay and Jellyfin servers running

description.p: Viewers in a room can now stream or download a video another YarmiplayTV viewer has through a cached file relay, the host can share Jellyfin with Syncplay users through a guest account and the Syncplay port, and a vanilla Syncplay mode turns all of it off.
Available on the Snap Store for Linux, with Jellyfin built in; the Snap Store keeps it up to date.
Tidier Syncplay settings: the fields line up in two columns and the password's Show button sits inside its box.
Updates get their own card on the dashboard, and a new About screen links to the website, YarmiplayTV and the source code.
Packaging improvements for the Microsoft Store.
Automatic updates from GitHub releases, and the control panel can be opened in a web browser on the same computer.
